segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ נִדְרֵי אוֹנָסִין, הִדִּירוֹ חֲבֵירוֹ שֶׁיֹּאכַל אֶצְלוֹ, וְחָלָה הוּא אוֹ שֶׁחָלָה בְּנוֹ אוֹ שֶׁעִכְּבוֹ נָהָר — הֲרֵי אֵלּוּ נִדְרֵי אוֹנָסִין.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» What are examples of «vows» impeded by «circumstances beyond» one’s «control?» If «one’s friend took a vow with regard to him that he should eat with him, and he became sick, or his son became sick, or a river» that he was unable to cross «barred him» from coming, «these are» examples of «vows» whose fulfillment are impeded by «circumstances beyond» one’s «control.» They are not binding and do not require dissolution.

moves.summary: Defines vows of duress by example

positions.claim: a vow to eat with a friend, prevented by illness or a river, is a vow of duress and not binding
